GBIF records of gentians in Austria

Source: R/data.R
gentiana.Rd

The occurrence records of the genus Gentiana that GBIF publishes with the country code AT (Austria) and a CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0 licence, taken from the GBIF snapshot of 1 October 2026. Specimens from herbaria and observations from surveys and citizen science, from the 18th century to 2026, with their coordinates, stated coordinate uncertainty and the fields GBIF fills during processing. Column names are those of the GBIF snapshot; occ_columns() matches them without renaming.

Usage

gentiana

Format

A data frame with 33,025 rows and 15 columns:

gbifid

GBIF record identifier.

datasetkey

GBIF dataset identifier; each record's licence and citation are those of its dataset.

kingdom, genus, species

Taxon, as matched by GBIF.

countrycode

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

decimallongitude, decimallatitude

Coordinates in decimal degrees, NA where the record has none.

coordinateuncertaintyinmeters

Stated coordinate uncertainty in metres.

year

Year the record was collected or observed.

basisofrecord

Darwin Core basis of record, for example PRESERVED_SPECIMEN or HUMAN_OBSERVATION.

institutioncode

Code of the institution holding the record.

establishmentmeans

Darwin Core establishment means.

issue

GBIF issue names, separated by ;.

license

Licence of the record: CC0_1_0 or CC_BY_4_0.

Source

GBIF.org (1 October 2026) GBIF Occurrence Download doi:10.15468/dl.tup2g6 . Records under CC BY 4.0 are attributed to their datasets, identified by datasetkey (https://www.gbif.org/dataset/<datasetkey>).

Examples

f <- flag_occurrences(gentiana, tests = c("invalid", "capital", "centroid", "institution"),
                      columns = occ_columns(id = "gbifid"))
summary(f, by = "basisofrecord")
